notes_for_editor: Only one source names this tower: the 2016 tnlandforms list (county, coordinates, elevation number, GFC number). Not on the cached NHLR or FFLOS Georgia lists, not on the Forest Lookouts Georgia list, and two searches turned up no history, status, access or photo source. The record's registers entry 'GFC US 2' is a Georgia Forestry Commission list number (gfc-002), not a national register number, so the registers field may need relabelling. The list's elevation column gives no unit; the record's 190.8 m assumes feet. The name 'rose hill' is the list author's, not a checked place name. Rose Hill Plantation in Elbert County (a historic house) and the Rose Hill lookout in Oregon are different places and were not used.
